$comment: experimental — mirrors bundles/base/manifest.json.provenance.status; shape may evolve. additionalProperties permissive during this stage.
title: Maestro MarkItDown Availability
description: Persisted by the maestro-onboarding skill (Step 5.5) and re-checked from CLAUDE.md every 30 days when unavailable. Records whether the markitdown CLI is present on the user's machine, unlocking document ingestion (PDF, Word, PowerPoint). Never mentioned to the user when unavailable — only surfaced on success.

available.description: true if markitdown --version returned successfully at checked_at.

version.description: Raw stdout of markitdown --version when available. Absent or null when available = false.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last availability check. Drives the 30-day re-check window.
